{{Quote|According to records, the Sith Lords might have gained greater knowledge of their subjects from an ancient Sith library temple on Krayiss II.|[[Seviss Vaa]], ''[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force]]''|<ref name="jvs">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
A '''[[library-temple]]''' was founded on [[Krayiss II]]<ref name="F&D CR" /> as a place for [[Sith sorcery/Legends|magicians]] of [[Sith (species)/Legends|pure Sith blood]] to gather to [[Meditation/Legends|meditate]] and set down the knowledge they had gained from their experiments.<ref name="darkside" /> It was a grand and enormous temple, that hosted the sum total of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] knowledge,<ref name="F&D CR" /> including [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] and artifacts about the Sith [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="jvs" /> However, the temple became abandoned circa 14,000 BBY, although the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]] of those Sith who inhabited the place still remained.<ref name="darkside" />
